subject: Reminder: Payment Due for Your Monthly Subscription
body: Dear Customer, This is a friendly reminder that the payment for your monthly subscription is due on the 15th of this month. Please ensure that your payment method is up to date to avoid any service interruptions. Thank you for being a valued customer and for your prompt attention to this matter. If you have any questions or need assistance, feel free to contact our customer support team. Best regards, Subscription Services
